description: Usman's Pure Products - High-End Interactive Hero Slider & Organic Brand Experience

userStories.title: Validate development environment and CLI dependencies
userStories.description: Ensure git, jq, and GitHub CLI (gh) are available and authenticated.
acceptanceCriteria: Script verifies availability of git, jq, and gh
Clear diagnostic output provided if any tool is missing
userStories.notes: Verified: jq installed, GitHub CLI installed and authenticated via OAuth device login

userStories.title: Build Official Brand Header Shell
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want a frosted glass navbar with official Usman's Pure branding, search, cart, and mobile menu.
acceptanceCriteria: Official logo displayed with transparent backdrop
Responsive navigation links with collection badges
Search modal dialog (Ctrl+K) and slide-over mini cart drawer
Dynamic theme integration matching active slide palette
userStories.notes: Implemented in src/components/Header.tsx with theme reactivity

userStories.title: Build 4-Second Interactive Product Slider Hero
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want an ultra-smooth, 4-second auto-advancing Hero slider with liquid wipe transitions matching the brand reference.
acceptanceCriteria: Slide 1: Wheat/Cream Amber Theme with giant kinetic 'MULTIGRAIN FLOUR' and Chakki Multigrain Flour product
Slide 2: Fresh Organic Green Theme with giant kinetic 'HERBAL TEAS' and Rosella & Olive Leaf Blend product
Slide 3: Warm Terracotta Theme with giant kinetic 'ORGANIC SPICES' and Kashmiri Chili & Whole Masalas
Continuous 4-second progress scrubber bar filling over exact 4000ms window
Interactive Play/Pause circular button on bottom-left and manual Prev/Next arrows
Floating frosted glass spec card with pack size selector, price, Add to Cart, and Learn More modal
100% mobile and laptop responsive with clamp() typography and no horizontal overflow
Typecheck and production build pass cleanly
userStories.notes: Implemented in src/components/ProductSliderHero.tsx and mounted in src/app/page.tsx

userStories.title: Purity Promise & Authentic Customer Assurance Section
userStories.description: As a buyer, I want clear trust pillars explaining stone-ground milling, organic sourcing, and lab-tested purity.
acceptanceCriteria: Trust grid highlighting stone-ground milling, organic farms, and lab testing
Official brand footer with copyright and guarantee seals
userStories.notes: Implemented on src/app/page.tsx beneath the hero slider
